Select: target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence
Source: target_dictionary, component_sequences
Join: target_dictionary.tid = target_components.tid; target_components.component_id = component_sequences.component_id
Filter: target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Sort: target_chembl_id ASC
Limit: None
